# intention-kernel/testing package

Declarative scenario evaluation, assertions, portable reports, and in-memory test helpers.

## Remarks

Import these APIs from `intention-kernel/testing` in the consuming application. Evaluations run through a compiled agent or an application-owned transport and return structured results for each case and acceptance criterion.
